clue.text: Composer and old lover dividing half of score

indicators.note: dividing means the second piece splits the first one apart by sitting inside it

parts.note: a score is twenty, so half of it is ten
leman is an archaic word for a lover or sweetheart

explanation.surface: A biographer pairs a composer with a former mistress who came between him and his music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dividing' puts LEMAN inside TEN, between TE and N. A score being twenty is a counting convention worth knowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Georg Philipp Telemann was a prolific German Baroque composer.

clue.text: Drum offered by male to maiden

parts.note: a tom is a male animal, especially a cat
M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A drum is passed from a man to a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden in cricket is an over in which no runs are scored, written M on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: A tom-tom is a tall narrow drum beaten with the hands or sticks.

clue.text: Religious music with archaically grotesque line in church

indicators.note: in means the following pieces are placed inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE stands for the Church of England
antic is an old word meaning grotesque or bizarre

explanation.surface: Sacred music performed with quaint, oddly old-fashioned phrasing in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'archaically' warns that the sense of grotesque needed is an old one, not today's playful meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: A canticle is a hymn or chant with a biblical text, sung in church services.

clue.text: Old instrument and piano at home in collection

indicators.note: in means the piano and home pieces go inside the word for a collection

parts.note: a set is a collection of things belonging together
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: An antique keyboard and a piano kept at home as part of a collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinet is a small harpsichord popular in the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: Religious works as originally scored

indicators.note: originally points to the letters as first arranged, now to be rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Sacred compositions performed just as the composer first wrote them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' is the anagram signal: SCORED is rearranged into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a musical setting of the Creed, a part of the Mass.

clue.text: Concert's opening with dance by popular composer

indicators.note: opening means take only the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A concert opens with a dance piece by a well-loved composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Frédéric Chopin was a Polish Romantic composer and pianist.

clue.text: Player at higher pitch missing opening

indicators.note: missing opening means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a note that is sharper is pitched higher

explanation.surface: A musician playing a little sharp, having missed the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing opening' drops the S from SHARPER.
explanation.definitionFit: A harper is someone who plays the harp, a kind of musical player.

clue.text: As required by patron, do special pieces of music

indicators.note: required by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Special compositions written on demand for a wealthy sponsor.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo is a musical form in which a main theme keeps recurring between episodes.

clue.text: Some of the strings in a big Strauss composition

indicators.note: composition means putting the letters together in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A large Strauss work featuring part of the string section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' looks musical but signals an anagram of A BIG STRAUSS.
explanation.definitionFit: Bass guitars are stringed instruments, so they are some of the strings in a band.

clue.text: Mussorgsky providing sets of notes ahead of time

indicators.note: ahead of means the first piece comes before the second in the answer

parts.note: modes are scales, sets of notes in a fixed order

explanation.surface: Mussorgsky composing scales well before they were due.
explanation.definitionFit: Mussorgsky the Russian composer had the first name Modest.

clue.text: Creating harmony with a ringing sound without turning head

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the ringing word goes around the other piece

parts.note: ting is the light sound of a bell ringing

indicators.note: turning means the word for head is read backwards

parts.note: nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: Making music in tune with a bell's chime, without looking round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses the slang word for head, and 'without', in its old sense of outside, wraps the bell's sound around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuning instruments to each other brings them into harmony.

clue.text: A leading singer, missing very briefly, returned in opera

indicators.note: returned means the whole run of letters is read backwards
missing means a letter is taken out of the singer's word

parts.note: a diva is a leading female opera singer
V is the short form of very

explanation.surface: A star soprano who briefly vanished came back in an opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' drops V from DIVA leaving DIA; A plus DIA is ADIA, and 'returned' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Aida is a famous opera by Verdi.

clue.text: Support for performer in mass — solo is cut out

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for mass in physics

indicators.note: out means the letters are thrown out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A soloist's part is dropped from a performance of a Mass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' signals an anagram of SOLO IS CUT, placed after M.
explanation.definitionFit: A pianist or cellist sits on a stool, which supports the performer.

clue.text: Music makers play casually in a form of tennis

indicators.note: in means the casual playing word is placed inside the other piece
a form of means the letters of the next word are recast in another shape

parts.note: to strum is to play a guitar casually

explanation.surface: Players strum idly during a relaxed game of tennis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a form of' rearranges the letters of tennis, and 'in' splits that rearrangement after its third letter to take the casual playing word.
explanation.definitionFit: Instruments are the devices that make music.

clue.text: Hurry central section in conducting passage conveying emotional response

parts.note: to tear is to rush or hurry

indicators.note: central section in means take the letters from the middle of the word

explanation.surface: A conductor rushes the middle passage of the piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'central section in' takes DUCT from the middle of conducting.
explanation.definitionFit: A tear duct carries tears, which are an emotional response.

clue.text: Part of brass band runs into grave individual

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the word for a grave

parts.note: a tomb is a grave
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A member of a brass band rushes into a solemn person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' looks like an adjective describing the individual, but it is a noun naming a burial place.
explanation.definitionFit: The trombone is a brass instrument played in brass bands.

clue.text: Composer's tangles

definitions.meaning: belonging to Maurice Ravel, the French composer of Boléro

explanation.definitionFit: The name of the composer Ravel, with possessive s, is also a verb meaning entangles.

clue.text: Musical genius carries little weight in the marketplace

indicators.note: in means the small weight goes inside the word for a marketplace

parts.note: a mart is a market
oz, the ounce, is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A great composer barely counts for anything in commercial terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is widely regarded as a musical genius.

clue.text: Conductor didn't allow listening to original recording

indicators.note: listening to means the word is taken as it is heard, not as spelt

parts.note: if something was banned it was not allowed
a master is the original recording from which copies are made

explanation.surface: A conductor refused to let anyone hear the first recording.
explanation.walkthrough: 'listening to' turns BANNED into its sound-alike BAND.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandmaster conducts a band, especially a military or brass band.

clue.text: Drunken revelry's beginning with vodka for noted Czech

indicators.note: drunken means the letters stagger into a new order
beginning means take only the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Drunken partying begins with vodka for a well-known Czech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning' gives R, and 'Drunken' rearranges R plus VODKA.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonín Dvořák was a celebrated Czech composer, noted in both senses.

clue.text: Something child plays with famous conductor

definitions.meaning: a baby's toy that makes noise when shaken

explanation.definitionFit: A baby's noisy toy shares its name with Sir Simon Rattle, the conductor.

clue.text: Source of notes of Bank of England, originally

indicators.note: originally means take the first letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: Where banknotes come from: the Bank of England, in the first place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests banknotes, but they are musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe is a woodwind instrument that produces musical notes.

clue.text: Apparatus for capturing performance of woodwind instrument

definitions.meaning: a tape or digital device that records sound
a simple fipple flute played in many schools

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a sound-capturing machine and a woodwind instrument.

clue.text: Drums of one sailor used in another's backing

indicators.note: used in means the first sailor goes inside the second word
backing means the second sailor's word is read in reverse

parts.note: a salt is another word for a sailor
AB, able seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: Drums belonging to one seaman are carried on another's back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses the second sailor's word, and 'used in' sets the first sailor inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tablas are a pair of small Indian hand drums.

clue.text: Chants arranged as piece of music

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are put in a new order, as music is arranged

explanation.surface: Chants arranged as a short musical composition.
explanation.definitionFit: A snatch is a short fragment of a song or tune.

clue.text: Mars, for example, part of thematic composition

definitions.meaning: the fourth world from the sun
one movement of Holst's suite The ..., each piece named for a world

explanation.definitionFit: Mars is a world orbiting the sun, and Holst's orchestral suite has one movement for each.
